name: Debate Camp Portsmouth, RI
description_short: Debate, public speaking and Model UN camp at Portsmouth Abbey School, offered as a 5-day day camp for rising 5th–10th graders and a 6-day/6-night overnight camp for rising 8th–11th graders. All ability levels are welcome.
swim_waterfront_notes: The overnight program includes an optional daily swim. The page gives no details about the pool or waterfront.

sessions.name: Overnight Camp (6 day / 6 night enriched program)

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (July 26 – August 1, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.
Prices are listed as the 'REGULAR RATE'. The page mentions a sibling discount and payment plans, so other rates may apply.
Grade and age ranges are different for the day camp (rising grades 5–10, ages 10–15) and the overnight camp (rising grades 8–11, ages 12–16).
The bus from Providence is for the day camp. Transport for the overnight camp is covered on a separate page.
